claims: The Golden State Warriors play the Phoenix Suns in an NBA Play-In Tournament elimination game.
The game is on Friday, April 17, 2026.
The game is at 7:00 p.m. PDT.
The game is at 10:00 p.m. EDT.
The game is at the Mortgage Matchup Center in Phoenix, AZ.
The game will be aired exclusively on Amazon Prime Video.
The winner of the Golden State Warriors vs. Phoenix Suns matchup takes the #8 seed in the playoffs.
The game can be listened to on SiriusXM App and local radio.
Kristaps Porziņģis is listed as questionable with ankle soreness.
The game determines who faces the top seed in the Western Conference.
